content.name: Ring of Free Action
entries: While you wear this ring, {@quickref difficult terrain||3} doesn't cost you extra movement. In addition, magic can neither reduce your speed nor cause you to be {@condition paralyzed} or {@condition restrained}.

content.name: Ring of Free Action
entries: While you wear this ring, {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|SRD52} doesn't cost you extra movement. In addition, magic can neither reduce any of your Speeds nor cause you to have the {@condition Paralyzed|SRD52} or {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition.
